name: How do I know if I have a hidden pipe leak?

mainEntity.name: How do I know if I have a hidden pipe leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of a hidden pipe leak include unexplained increases in your water bill, damp spots on walls, ceilings, or floors, musty odors indicating mold growth, or the sound of running water when no fixtures are in use. A sudden drop in water pressure can also be a red flag. If you suspect a hidden leak, it's crucial to contact a professional to avoid extensive water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for unexplained high water bills, damp spots, musty smells, or the sound of running water when nothing is on. A sudden drop in water pressure can also signal a hidden leak.
